versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

- Clarified required inputs: now explicitly requires category plus budget/region, or specific account links/handles, before starting a shortlist.
- Added scope note: clarified that the package delivers a shortlist only—outreach messaging and sending are out of scope.
- Updated default behaviors: does not default to profile-only lookups and requires content evidence for recent work and topic fit.
- Removed skill-card.md file.
- Minor documentation updates for greater accuracy and workflow precision.
Publish the reviewed Influencer Fit Analyzer workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
